name: deck-design-system
title_zh: 低饱和浅色系 + IBM Plex 的 16:9 投
tagline_zh: 做投影片前先读它：字级、配色、版面几何一次定死。不用再猜「这页对不对」，检查外观时它直接告诉你哪里越界。
tagline_en: Read before making slides: type scale, palette, grid geometry all pinned. Stop guessing if a page is right—it.
desc_en: The visual specification for decks — a low-saturation light palette, a small-type scale built for density, a 16:9 grid with exact geometry, and the IBM Plex typeset. Read this before producing or reviewing any slide visual, deck colour, typography or layout geometry. Chinese triggers: 簡報配色 / 字級 / 版面規格 / 檢查投影片外觀.
why_zh: 把视觉决策从「凭感觉」变成「查表」。低饱和浅色系防投影刺眼，小字级密度扛得住满页信息。
why_en: Turns visual choices from gut feel into lookup tables. Low-sat light palette avoids glare, dense type scale handles info-heavy.
limit_zh: 只认简报视觉规范，不碰内容架构或动画逻辑。需要 IBM Plex 字体已安装；若你惯用高饱和深色主题或 4:3 版式。
limit_en: Covers slide visuals only—not content structure or animation. Requires IBM Plex fonts installed. If you favor high-sat dark themes or 4:3, it will.
title_en: Low-sat light palette, IBM Plex, 16:9 grid for slides
